app.menu.checkForUpdates.comment: Command in the application menu (under About) and button on the About page that asks Sparkle to check for a newer release now. Ends with an ellipsis because it opens the update progress/result sheet.

about.updates.automatic.comment: Toggle label on the About page that controls whether Sparkle checks the release feed for updates automatically in the background.
about.updates.automatic.fr: Vérifier automatiquement les mises à jour
about.updates.automatic.ja: アップデートを自動的に確認
about.updates.automatic.hi: अपने आप अपडेट की जाँच करें
